name: Multi-view Feature Consistency via Linear Interpolation
definition: A method to derive a differentiable surface point from volume rendering samples using linear interpolation of SDF zero-crossings, used to enforce multi-view feature consistency.
summary: Multi-view Feature Consistency via Linear Interpolation extracts differentiable surface points by linearly interpolating SDF zero-crossings, differing from sibling methods by using a single secant step instead of recursive root-finding.
